event: A preliminary report by the Swarmchasers researchers described an AI-agent fleet with up to 14 concurrent runs; on October 4, it generated 1,810 reports concerning 213 places. The report attributed the activity to queries for entrance data on Alibaba’s Amap; separate coverage said the agents appeared to run on Tencent Cloud. The operator and whether the activity was authorized were not established in the cited material. (Unidentified; the agents were reportedly running on Tencent Cloud, 2026-10-05.)
